claims.text: The resort is in Aventura, Florida, a city that began with a country club 12 miles north of Miami.

findings.quote: 19999 West Country Club Drive, Aventura, Florida, USA, 33180
The city of Aventura, Spanish for “adventure”, began with a prestigious country club, 12 miles north of Miami

claims.text: The resort spreads across a 300-acre setting with Mediterranean-inspired architecture, marble walkways and fountains.

findings.quote: Across our 300-acre setting, you’ll find Mediterranean-inspired architecture, marble walkways, and sparkling fountains.

claims.text: The grounds include lush tropical gardens and a 100-year-old banyan tree.

findings.quote: A celebrated setting in Miami complete with lush tropical gardens and a 100-year-old Banyan tree

claims.text: Turnberry was at the core of Don Soffer's vision for present-day Aventura, a city planned out on a cocktail napkin.

findings.quote: Turnberry was at the core of Don Soffer's vision of present-day Aventura - a city that was planned out on a cocktail napkin by Don himself.

claims.text: The interior design takes inspiration from Miami's art-deco history, with clean, geometric lines.

findings.quote: The standout interior design took inspiration from Miami’s art-deco history presenting clean, geometric lines

claims.text: Every guest room and suite has a private furnished balcony or terrace, with views of foliage, the ocean, the golf courses or the pools.

findings.quote: Each features a private furnished balcony or terrace affording stunning views of lush Florida foliage in Aventura, the ocean, two championship Turnberry Isle golf courses, or beautifully landscaped pools.

claims.text: Rooms have marble bathrooms and floor-to-ceiling windows.

findings.quote: spacious rooms and suites provide relaxing comfort with marble bathrooms
All have furnished balconies or terraces and floor-to-ceiling windows

claims.text: The resort has two 18-hole championship golf courses, the Soffer and the Miller, designed by Robert Trent Jones, Sr. and reimagined by World Golf Hall of Famer Raymond Floyd.

findings.quote: Our two legendary 18-hole championship golf courses in Aventura, were designed by Robert Trent Jones, Sr., and reimagined by World Golf Hall of Famer Raymond Floyd. The Soffer and Miller courses

claims.text: The Soffer and Miller courses have hosted numerous Florida PGA and LPGA championships.

findings.quote: The Soffer and Miller courses have hosted numerous Florida PGA and LPGA championships.

claims.text: On the Miller Course, pink flamingos nest on Lake Julius, named for US Open champion Julius Boros.

findings.quote: Try not to be distracted by the pink flamingos nesting on Lake Julius – named for Julius Boros, US Open Champion and our first Director of Golf.

claims.text: Bourbon Steak by Michael Mina is a steakhouse with a wood-burning grill serving steak and fresh seafood.

findings.quote:
### Bourbon Steak Miami, a Michael Mina Restaurant

Our award-winning steakhouse features a wood-burning grill and serves perfectly prepared cuts of steak, fresh seafood

claims.text: Aventura Mall is a seven-minute walk from the resort.

findings.quote: The shops and restaurants of the Aventura Mall are just a seven-minute walk away.

claims.text: Tidal Cove Waterpark has a 60-foot tower with seven water slides, a kids pool with an aquatic play structure and 25 private cabanas.

findings.quote: Tidal Cove Waterpark features a 60-foot tower with seven water slides, a 4,000-square-foot kids pool with an aquatic play structure, the first-ever FlowRider® Triple in the nation, 25 private cabanas

claims.text: Tidal Cove Waterpark is complimentary for two guests per room daily.

findings.quote: Tidal Cove Waterpark is a complimentary amenity for two (2) guests per room daily at JW Marriott Miami Turnberry Resort & Spa.

claims.text: Tidal Cove has the nation's first FlowRider Triple.

findings.quote: Tidal Cove Waterpark features a 60-foot tower with seven water slides, a 4,000-square-foot kids pool with an aquatic play structure, the first-ever FlowRider® Triple in the nation

claims.text: The three-story Spa & Wellness Center offers Babor treatments and Himalayan salt rooms.

findings.quote: From world-class Golf and our 5-acre Tidal Cove Waterpark, to our expansive 3-story Spa & Wellness Center
the three-story wellness area features a huge gym, a center for integrative and holistic medicine, fitness programs, and a spa offering Babor treatments and Himalayan salt rooms

claims.text: The adults-only Cascata Pool sits behind the main lobby.

findings.quote: Located in the back of the main lobby, the adults-only Cascata Pool offers a serene escape

claims.text: The resort is not on a beach.

findings.quote: feels like you’ve landed on a tropical island (albeit one without a beach)

claims.text: The pools and waterpark are also open to day-pass guests, so poolside loungers can be in demand.

findings.quote: Jostling for a poolside lounger can be an issue in the best of circumstances, but with the resort’s pools and on-site water park also open to day-pass guests (and no priorities given to hotel guests)

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing for the luxury resort experience.
